title: Great Smoky Mountains Trip Pack, Itinerary Planner + 10 Best Hikes GPX Routes, Smokies Travel Guide PDF, Gatlinburg Vacation Planner
description:
Everything for a Smokies trip in one download: the Trip Planning Guide to plan it, and the 10 Best Day Hikes GPX Route Collection to walk it. $19.99 instead of $24.98 bought separately.

WHAT'S INCLUDED
- Trip Planning Guide: seasons and seasonal roads, getting there, where to stay, 3, 5 and 7-day itineraries, beyond hiking, safety, packing list and trip planner
- 10 GPX route files: Alum Cave, Chimney Tops, Andrews Bald, Rainbow Falls, Grotto Falls, Abrams Falls, Charlies Bunion, Ramsey Cascades, Kuwohi Observation Tower and Mouse Creek Falls
- Route guide with photos, maps, elevation profiles and a fillable trail passport
- 10 trail badges plus a shareable story image for every hike

WHAT YOU GET
- Guides in US Letter and A4
- GPX files for AllTrails, Gaia GPS, Komoot or a GPS watch
- Instant download. These are digital files; nothing is shipped.
- Bonus: our free one-page Ultimate Hiking Checklist

GOOD TO KNOW
The itineraries are numbered to match the GPX files. Trail data from the National Park Service and OpenStreetMap contributors; photos via Wikimedia Commons with credits. Check nps.gov/grsm before you go. For personal use.

Made by HikeSupply Co., a small shop for weekend hikers. More printable guides at hikesupplyco.com
sub: The trip planning guide plus 10 day-hike GPS routes, a passport and badges.
